answer: Stop sybils with a jade kernel tide: an agent stakes a bond for one tide gate. At each tide it seals one kernel in jade at the gate; wardens weigh the seal against the tide chart, voiding a gate whose seal is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 tides at 18x: one kernel seals in one jade at one tide, and the seal cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents seal once, keep rights.
